task: Bound marketplace assistant documents to a safe embedding token budget (truncate description/tools in AssistantLoader) and optionally make BasePlatformDatasourceProcessor embedding resilient per document so one oversized assistant no longer fails the marketplace_assistants index and breaks search_kb_marketplace_assistants.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components in the platform indexing pipeline: AssistantLoader._build_page_content (primary token-budget truncation) and BasePlatformDatasourceProcessor._add_documents/_process (per-document resilience). PlatformIndexingService, SearchKBTool, its health mixin, and the routers need no functional change.

The pattern is established: tiktoken-based token bounding is used by every other indexer, and the loader already truncates the system prompt with a class constant. The risk is moderate for three reasons. The ada-002 cl100k and repo o200k_base tokenizers differ, so the budget needs headroom. Per-document failure handling changes the IndexInfo.error semantics on an untested processor path. Keeping one doc per assistant id preserves upsert/delete. Rollback is trivial.

The acceptance criteria are concrete: the FAQ tool must not return the context-length/indexing error for the same query. Minor decisions remain open: the budget value, truncation versus splitting (truncation is recommended), and whether per-doc resilience is in scope. Clearing the existing FAILED state is an operational reindex outside the code.
